name: Perceptron ML
long_description: Perceptron ML tracks anything you want, anywhere it happens. Tell us in plain English what matters, new lawsuits, layoffs, price drops, listings, RFPs, breaking news, and we watch the news, filings, databases, and the open web for it. You get notified instantly, hourly, daily, or weekly, by email, on a live dashboard, or directly into your agents and workflows through our API and MCP.
one_liner: Live alerts for anything happening in the world.
